identity_scope: The aqueous supernatant obtained by the NBRC1356 Mineral base 1 protocol.
preparation_facts: Charge Na2CO3 185 g, NaHCO3 35 g, NaCl 16 g and K2HPO4 1 g to distilled water 1 L. Autoclave under nitrogen; after one day of precipitation use only supernatant. Stated final pH is 10.
excluded_or_unresolved: The charged salts and their masses are precursor inputs, not asserted retained solutes or dissolved concentrations. Supernatant recovery volume is unknown. Nitrogen atmosphere is a process condition and is not a component.
comparison: Preparation identity is supported despite unmeasured dissolved composition; PARTIAL assertion includes only the known aqueous carrier.
